topic: Reflecting on a high-stakes pitch rejection from a national platform
caption:
They loved the “local texture”—which is just polite Bombay-speak for “no, thank you.” 

Three months of sleepless nights and pitch decks, gone in a fifteen-minute Zoom call. It stings, especially when you really believe in the world you built. 

But the desk gets cleared, the coffee gets remade, and we start writing the next draft. We go again.

#OdiaCinema #Screenwriting #PitchLife #Storytelling
